payout_quote: Official Mindswarms help page: '$10–$50, sometimes more, per study', paid within 24 hours through PayPal. Typical study: 1-7 one-minute video responses.
timing: Paid within 24 hours through PayPal after completing a study.
biggest_catch: You must be invited and qualify for each study — worldwide signup, but income is irregular and depends on matching study criteria.
catches: Studies are invite/qualification-based — worldwide signup does not mean steady studies.
Pay range is $10–$50 per study ('sometimes more'); the low end is $10, not $50.
You need a device able to record short video responses.
steps: Go to https://www.mindswarms.com/ and sign up as a participant (worldwide).
Complete your profile so you can be matched to studies.
When invited, answer the study's 1-7 one-minute video-response questions.
Receive $10–$50 (sometimes more) per completed study via PayPal within 24 hours.
eligibility: Worldwide signup; must qualify for each individual study based on its criteria.
notes: Verified against the official Mindswarms help page observed 2026-09-23. The route claims $50 — official says $10–$50 (sometimes more) per study, so $50 is the top of the official range, not a typical payout. The app must present the range and the qualification catch, not '$50 per study'.
